name: hnswlib Open-Source Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
free_limit: Apache-2.0 header-only C++ library with Python bindings for local HNSW approximate nearest-neighbor search; no software license fee or vendor-imposed index/query quota.
watch_out: This is a local search library, not a hosted vector-search API or free cloud service. You supply memory, CPU, storage, embeddings, application hosting and backups; third-party embedding APIs and infrastructure can cost money. Observe Apache-2.0 license notices.
